associations.rationale: The formal type exposes a tensor-product type for a right and a left module, but not its construction as a free abelian group modulo the displayed relations.

The equality states additivity in the first argument, but it does not itself state the free-abelian-group quotient construction, second-argument additivity, or balancing relation, so it is partial evidence.
The equality states the balancing relation, but it does not itself state the free-abelian-group quotient construction or both additivity relations, so it is partial evidence.
This declaration constructs pure tensors in the tensor-product type but does not itself state additivity or the balancing quotient relation.

The equality states additivity in the second argument, but it does not itself state the free-abelian-group quotient construction, first-argument additivity, or balancing relation, so it is partial evidence.
